name: vidya-vrtti
description: Vidya-Vrtti: Unified Scholarship & Admin Portal for Ministry of Tribal Affairs (MoTA)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "yellow.bold,cyan.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); try{fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true});}catch(e){console.error(e)}"
